meaning:
Kirjath-baal = "city of Baal"
a city on the northern boundary of Judah and on the western and southern boundaries of Benjamin
also 'Kirjath-jearim' and 'Baalah'
Another name of qir.yat ye.a.rim (קִרְיַת יְעָרִים "Kiriath-jearim" H7157)

elsewhere.note: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
